title: Support OpenCode reasoning variants
outcome: Expose OpenCode's live ACP effort/variant config option in session settings. Persist auto or an explicit agent-advertised selection, show the current effective variant and dynamic model-specific choices in the UI, and apply/reconcile it through acknowledged session/set_config_option requests after session new/resume/load and live updates. Add backend, wire, persistence, optimistic UI, and interaction coverage without hardcoding provider-specific variant names.
